name: Javed Khanani
real_life_parallel: Real Javed Khanani — Altaf's brother, KKI co-founder; died 4 Dec 2016

biography.background: Co-founder of Khanani & Kalia International with brother Altaf. India-facing operations specialist for FICN distribution and hawala networks. Died 4 December 2016 — 26 days after demonetisation.
biography.criminal_enterprise: KKI India operations; FICN placement; cross-border hawala; narco-jihad financing
biography.death_circumstances: Disputed — natural death, suicide, or assassination unconfirmed. Timing (26 days post-demonetisation) highly suspicious.

risk_profile.description: Operational risk-taker; physical exposure in India-facing work

intelligence_signature.pattern: Cross-border movement; cash handling; border city operations

demonetisation_connection.implication: FICN network destruction may have triggered death (stress, suicide, or targeted elimination)
demonetisation_connection.film_significance: Climax of demonetisation as financial warfare
